name: zaeku
description: Agent skills written and revised alongside the agents that read them.

plugins.name: version-control
plugins.description: Work inside a Jujutsu repository without losing anyone's files. Covers inspection, changes, history edits, conflicts, recovery, bookmarks and Git remotes. Verified against jj 0.45.1.

plugins.name: agent-authoring
plugins.description: Apply nine rules to instructions an agent will read: skills, system prompts, AGENTS.md, tool descriptions. Eight come from ASD-STE100, and one keeps the reason for an instruction out of the file. Also diagnoses an instruction an agent skipped or half-followed.

plugins.name: load-agents-dot-md
plugins.description: For Claude Code only: a SessionStart hook that prints the project root AGENTS.md into the context. Claude Code injects CLAUDE.md on its own and never AGENTS.md, and the lazy load of a nested instruction file fires on the Read tool, which auto mode does not use.
